title: case to_integer(unsigned(val)) expression selector in a process
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: A combinational 7-segment decoder whose case selector is the EXPRESSION to_integer(unsigned(val)), not a plain signal. Regression fence for the 2026-10-11 CaseStructure fix: before it, an expression case selector left the whole statement a no-op (not even `when others` fired), so the output stayed stuck. The input is driven directly so GHDL ground truth and Kmila decode identical inputs with no clock/reset races — every arm plus `others` must match.
